_about: Public-domain H. B. Swete (Henry Barclay Swete, 1835-1917, Regius Professor of Divinity at Cambridge) for the Word Hoard: 20 books from Internet Archive scans, 1868-1921, among them his commentaries on St Mark (1898) and the Apocalypse (1906), An Introduction to the Old Testament in Greek (1900), and his studies of the Holy Spirit (1873-1912). His editions of the Septuagint, Theodore of Mopsuestia and other ancient texts are left off as editions. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
